ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between light grey/white ventral regions (approx. 65% of visible fluke) and dark black pigmentation (approx. 35%) along the edges and in linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) region dominates the central-right fluke lobe, punctuated by low-intensity (black) linear streaks radiating from the trailing edge. The distal tips are predominantly dark.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Visible right lobe trailing edge exhibits irregular, high-amplitude peaks caused by macro-scale bio-fouling (barnacles) rather than underlying dermal structure. The natural edge appears moderately serrated between clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the right lobe's trailing edge, terminating in a sharp, posteriorly-oriented distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast, 3D-textured clusters of brownish-tan pixels (barnacles) localized at the distal tips of both lobes and along the right trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least five parallel, low-intensity (black) vertical rake marks visible across the light-intensity ventral field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive colonization of sessile barnacles along the trailing edges and tips; visible rake marks on the ventral surface of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant water-splash occlusion at the peduncle-fluke interface, masking the median notch and the proximal third of the fluke lobes.
